hero_section.cta_segmentation_notes: Segment users BEFORE commitment (Individual/Couples/Teen reduces friction)
hero_section.conversion_signal: 'Get matched to a therapist' or 'Find a therapist' - action-oriented, not vague

tone_and_language.tone_notes: Blend empathy (make them feel okay) with expertise (prove competence). Avoid sterile/clinical. Zero pressure/scarcity.

social_proof.specificity_notes: Testimonials must include: name, photo, specific outcome. e.g., 'Sarah M.: Helped me manage anxiety during work stress'
social_proof.diversity_signals: Show diverse ages, genders, ethnicities, use cases (individuals, couples, parents, teens)
social_proof.outcome_quantification: Qualitative (specific stories) > Quantitative (% improved) for this vertical

visual_hierarchy.whitespace_notes: Generous whitespace signals calm and safety. Anxious users scan, don't read dense text.
visual_hierarchy.color_temperature_notes: Cool colors (blue, teal, green) signal calm. Avoid warm oranges/reds, pure medical white.
visual_hierarchy.psychology_notes: Cool palette = trust + calm. Green = growth/healing. Blue = stability.

friction_removal_techniques: reassurance language: 'cancel anytime', 'message at your pace'
what_fails_if_removed: diverse testimonials with outcomes → credibility gap
whitespace and calm layout → abandonment (feels clinical)

stage_indicators.trust_buildup_sequence: credentialing → patient stories → outcome proof → flexibility reassurance

vertical_specific_patterns.credentialing_requirement: CRITICAL. Therapist qualifications, licensing, experience. This is THE core trust signal.
vertical_specific_patterns.insurance_coverage: IMPORTANT. Cost is major barrier. Lead with '$0 copay' if available.
vertical_specific_patterns.matching_mechanism: Users want to know they'll be matched to RIGHT therapist. Make process transparent.
vertical_specific_patterns.confidentiality_language: Safe space, private, secure messaging. Mental health seekers have trust concerns.
vertical_specific_patterns.ethical_tone: Avoid scarcity/urgency language. Mental health seekers have high fraud awareness. Be authentic.
